patterns.cli_pattern: Uses sys.argv for argument parsing, --flag syntax for options
patterns.finding_pattern: Finding class with slots (path, line, severity, code, what, fix)
patterns.severity_levels: blocker, major, minor (defined in SEVERITY_ORDER dict)
patterns.rule_categories: COLOR, FONT, ITALIC, SPACING, CHEVRON, ELECTRIC
patterns.output_pattern: ANSI colored console output with color detection (sys.stdout.isatty())
patterns.html_pattern: Self-contained HTML with inline CSS (no external dependencies), seen in index.html

existing_implementations.description: brand-check.py already has Finding class, severity levels, rule categories, and console reporting. The script scans HTML/CSS/MD/SVG files for brand violations.

key_functions.check_file: Returns list of Finding objects for a single file
key_functions.collect: Gathers all files to scan from paths
key_functions.report: Outputs findings to console (text format only)
key_functions.Finding.__init__: Creates a finding with (path, line, severity, code, what, fix)

new_functionality.historical_data: Store reports in reports/ directory with timestamps for trend analysis
